note: Hand-kept, not extracted. Notes the document prints under a table rather than beside a row. `qualifications.json` is keyed by one address and cannot hold these: a statement about what changing the drum set does is about the whole table, and one about two parameters not working at once is about the two of them together, not about either alone.
why_it_matters: A note attached to a table is still something the document states, and dropping it because the schema was the wrong shape would leave the site quieter than the page it was read from. None of these suppresses a verdict -- they are not about a stated value -- so each is shown beside the addresses it names and says what would have to be measured to hold it against anything.
how_scope_was_decided: A note names its subject in words and the page does not draw a box around what it covers, so the addresses each one reaches are a reading. Each entry says which reading was taken, so somebody who disagrees with the scope can see it rather than having to reconstruct it from the list.

statements.restated: The document states that modifying the LFO 1 and LFO 2 parameters may not always produce the intended effect.
statements.read_as: The note is printed at the end of the controller-assignment tables and names the LFO parameters rather than a table, so it is taken to reach every row in those tables whose parameter name is an LFO 1 or LFO 2 one -- all six controllers, across both pages the tables span, rather than only the block the note happens to sit under.
statements.open: It states a limit on an effect rather than a value, so nothing in the address records answers it. What would: the audible contrast the archive already measures, run on these addresses, which would show which of them a reader can hear and which they cannot.

statements.restated: The document states that changing the drum set initialises every drum setup parameter.
statements.read_as: The note is printed under the drum setup table and names that table's parameters, so it is taken to reach every row of it.
statements.open: It states what one message does to a table, which is a reset by another name and is the shape of thing the archive's reset probe measures. Nothing has put a drum set change to this unit and read these addresses back, so what the document states here stands beside no measurement at all.

statements.restated: The document states that one drum instrument cannot use chorus send and delay send at the same time.
statements.read_as: The note names the two parameters, and the two rows carrying those names are the whole of what it reaches. It is about the pair rather than about either of them, which is why it is here rather than restated twice as a qualification.
statements.open: The write probe writes one address at a time and reads it back, so it would find both of these accepting a value and say nothing about what happens when both hold one. What would answer it is an audible comparison with each set alone and with both set together.
